text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: —The day before the Japan Cup.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
...Tomorrow is finally the 'Japan Cup.' 
There's something I wanted to tell 
everyone today.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
"……Once again, thank you so much for all 
your support♪ I think... maybe... I'm――"

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
"If it weren't for everyone and you, 
Trainer, I don't think I would have 
challenged this year's Japan Cup."

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
"If it weren't for everyone and you, 
Trainer, I don't think I would have 
challenged this year's Japan Cup."

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
"That's just how amazing of a horse girl 
Ai-san is to me. But—"

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
...Throughout the days leading up to 
today, everyone has given me so much love.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: "And everyone... has accepted my love."

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
"Being able to support and help each 
other. Such a wonderful... vast and warm 
bond truly exists here."

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
"That's what Loves Only You's true 
strength is. ...Everyone taught me that."

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
That's why I can challenge it. With 
confidence――towards becoming the 
strongest.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Look forward to it. To the moment we 
shine.

text_block_list.name: Easily Bored Girl
text_block_list.text:
"I'll be watching your challenge all the 
way, Loves-chan!! I'm in the middle of 
launching a whole new business myself! 
Let's take on this challenge together!"

text_block_list.name: Hardworker@Overseas Assignment
text_block_list.text:
"Seriously, seeing Loves-chan work so hard 
makes me feel like I can't complain about 
a new place or whatever. Guess I'd better 
give it my all too!"

text_block_list.name: Passionate Teacher
text_block_list.text:
"Thanks to Loves-chan, even when things 
are rough, I can keep going with my 
serialization. ...I don't wanna give up 
either, I wanna shine."

text_block_list.name: Middle-Aged Gym Bro
text_block_list.text:
"Thank you for always giving me the will 
to live. I'm really looking forward to the 
Japan Cup."

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
—Bearing their crowns, the champions 
assemble now. Today, every race fan will 
witness a legend!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
The match of the century, the Japan Cup! 
Post time is almost upon us!

text_block_list.name: Race Fan A
text_block_list.text:
Man, I'm so glad they started lifting 
spectator restrictions recently...! I just 
had to see this race in person...!

text_block_list.name: Race Fan B
text_block_list.text:
There aren't many spectators, so it's a 
bit lonely... But still, the heat of the 
race doesn't change! I've gotta burn this 
legend into my memory...!

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: —Hey, Trainer-kun.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: —Hey, Trainer-chan.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: ...Can I hold your hand?

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: Aww, aren't you even gonna blush?
choice_data_list: It's my trainee's request, after all

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
...Well then, I'd give that an 80, I 
guess~

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: You have to properly add 'my beloved'♡

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I take her outstretched hand. ......I can 
feel her trembling.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: ...Are you a little disappointed?
choice_data_list: No, I'm actually happy about it.
No, I'm actually happy about it.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...Because now, I can share in her 
trembling—

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: ...That was a perfect score just now ♡

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: —Well, I'm heading out.
choice_data_list: Let's show them the ultimate love!

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: Yeah!

text_block_list.name: Race Fan A
text_block_list.text:
"Ooooh...! Daring Tact looks so 
majestic...!! She truly carries the aura 
of a Triple Tiara champion!"

text_block_list.name: Race Fan B
text_block_list.text:
"Everyone in this race is truly 
incredible...!! Still, at the end of the 
day—"

text_block_list.name: Race Fan C
text_block_list.text:
“Her presence is insane even through the 
screen...! Almond Eye really is in a 
league of her own...!!”

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: ...How incredible.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
"I thought I already knew that Loves-chan 
had overcome her hurdles since autumn."

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: Still, the you of today—is even stronger.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
...Right now, I am overflowing with love. 
More than――――any other time in my life.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
So today, I'll unleash it all! All of my 
love, onto you, Ai-san!!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: Fufu— Just what I was hoping for...!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
I'll beat you fair and square and show you 
in person. ――The Umamusume who will become 
a legend!!

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: —Let's go, everyone.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: (To make our love shine brightly!!)
